primitives.name: Customer Impact Observer
primitives.verbatim_quote: # NEXT-060: Customer-impact reliability dashboard ## Repo(s) SigNoz, PostHog ## Category Reliability ## Goal Implement or design the customer-impact reliability dashboard capability for GSE / GSN without touching production data first.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'n': 'dimensionless, number of observed metrics', 's': 'state vector of system variables', 't': 'time index'}
primitives.assumptions: System state \( s(t) \) evolves stochastically; metrics \( \mathcal{O}(s(t)) \) are bounded and measurable.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When \( \mathcal{O}(s(t)) \) exceeds threshold \( \theta \), system enters degraded mode.

layer2.mapping: The observer maps system state to customer impact via \( \mathcal{O}: \mathcal{S} \to \mathbb{R}^n \), aligning with GSI's probabilistic inference engine.
layer2.telemetry: Observable metrics such as session duration, error rate, and conversion funnel drop-off.

primitives.name: Autonomous Operational Kernel
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## Why It Matters This increases GSE's ability to operate autonomously, learn from users, improve conversion, reduce SaaS cost, and make product/marketing decisions from evidence.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'p': 'probability of successful autonomous action', 'c': 'cost per unit time', 'u': 'user engagement score'}
primitives.assumptions: Operational decisions are made via \( \arg\max_p \mathbb{E}[u] - c \cdot t \).
primitives.breakdown_regime: When \( p < \epsilon \), fallback to manual intervention.

layer2.mapping: Kernel \( \mathcal{K}(u, c) \) enables GSE to compute optimal autonomy levels based on user feedback and cost-benefit analysis.
layer2.telemetry: Decision latency, conversion rate change, and cost-per-acquisition variance.

primitives.name: Observability Enabler
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## Founder/Internal Value The team gets measurable workflows, fewer manual steps, better observability, and clearer build priorities.
primitives.assumptions: Observability improves via \( o = f(w, m) \) where \( f \) is monotonically increasing.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When \( o < \delta \), manual steps become dominant.

layer2.mapping: Enables GSE to derive \( \mathcal{O}_{\text{internal}} \) from \( \mathcal{O}_{\text{external}} \), supporting internal workflow optimization.
layer2.telemetry: Number of alerts, mean time to resolution, and developer task completion rate.
